source2023.title: Hybridization may endanger the rare North Apennine endemic Cirsium bertolonii
source2023.supplement: Online Resource 6, primary morphometrics excluding achenes
source2023.unit: Same individual has middle leaf, involucre, and corolla measured. Leaf and head data do NOT measure evolutionary selection, heritability, biomechanics, or ecological interactions.

design.cv: sample SD divided by arithmetic mean, positive traits
design.aggregate: geometric mean of six per-stratum leaf/organ CV ratios, each stratum equal weight
design.bootstrap: 3000 paired-plant resamples within each fixed species-sex stratum, seed 20261008
design.confidence_scope: conditional on three sampled taxa and their localities, NOT cross-species phylogenetic or independent localities

source2026.title: Phylotranscriptomics and genome-size evidence clarify the Taiwanese Cirsium japonicum complex and delimit C. brevicaule and allied East Asian thistles
source2026.caveat: Mean±SD source tables; no individual-level organ pairing or complete group sizes recovered; units are named taxon/morphotype groups, not phylogenetically independent lineages.

interpretation.supported: In one same-plant European Cirsium dataset, relative variation in length decreases from middle leaf to involucre to corolla within every measured species-sex stratum; independently, six East Asian/Ryukyu morph groups have lower floret-length CVs than rosette-leaf and whole-head length CVs. Whole-head stability is NOT universal (purple takaoense head-length CV exceeds leaf).
not_supported: A numerical rate of evolutionary trait change
Leaf/organ comparability of actual mechanical spine defence
Adaptation due to pollinator or parasitoid guilds
Universal trend across all 250-300 Cirsium species
interpretation.next_discriminator: Matched common-garden populations + within-plant leaf position and head phenology + direct botanical phyllary/spine force, plus legitimate pollen transfer and antagonist/parasitoid attack leading to viable achenes. Test whether internal floret variance persists as stable while external architecture's ecological fitness value switches.

repo_boundary: The frozen Azami GEB manuscript is not amended; aza3 adds independent empirical cross-organ reanalysis.

phenotypic_covariance_2023.method: Log lengths centered within each of the six parental taxon×sex strata, residual Pearson r pooled over plants; 3,000 paired plant resamples; primary 2023 source xlsx hash frozen.
phenotypic_covariance_2023.interpretation: The same-plant phenotypic association among two reproductive head dimensions is larger than that between leaf and involucre lengths, even with descriptive covariate adjustment. The association can reflect within-head allometry, condition and developmental timing; not proof of genetic/developmental modularity or reproductive stabilizing selection.
phenotypic_covariance_2023.allometry_adjustment_risk: Controlling head width and vegetative size may block biological pathways or induce collider bias; report as sensitivity only.
